verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents outbound webhooks for usage/event tracking, letting external systems subscribe to events like sync completions ([fivetran-docs-47]), and it can send alerts via its dashboard ([fivetran-docs-15]). However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose, developer-facing webhook subscription API for arbitrary event types (e.g., data changes, connector state) beyond usage tracking, nor documentation of payload schemas, retry semantics, or event catalogs suited to AI-native/agentic consumption. missing for 10: full webhook event catalog/documentation, payload/retry specs, broader event coverage beyond usage tracking, and independent confirmation of webhook reliability.
